title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Seattle & Bellevue | PetTripFinder
meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across Greater Seattle -- downtown, Pike Place and the waterfront, Seattle Center, South Lake Union, Capitol Hill, the University District, SEA airport, Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland and Renton -- with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel's own official website.
introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel's own official website.
_boundary_note: Membership is the property's OWN postal code, as its own official page or its brand's own property card states it, joined to the corridor registry. A Seattle / Bellevue / Puget Sound downtown, waterfront, cruise, convention, stadium, corporate, university, medical, airport and Eastside travel market -- the contiguous metro from Lynnwood and Bothell to Federal Way, and from Ballard and West Seattle to Issaquah. Not 'Puget Sound': Tacoma, Olympia, Everett, Bellingham and Kitsap / Bremerton / Bainbridge are future standalone markets; Auburn and the outer King County ring are refused. Nothing else admits a property: not a brand's 'Seattle' marketing name, not a map pin, not a vacation-rental listing, not a competitor directory's city label. Patient, charitable and on-base lodging is never admitted.
_corridor_note: Corridors are a postal-code partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY). The postal city 'SEATTLE' spans seven corridors and places nothing by itself. Shared codes are covered whole: 98109 by Seattle Center and South Lake Union; 98188 by SeaTac and Tukwila; 98198 by SeaTac and Des Moines; 98133 by Seattle and Shoreline; 98012 by Bothell and Mill Creek. Pike Place, the Waterfront, the Convention Center, Seattle Center, South Lake Union, SEA and Tukwila are overlays.
_census_membership_note: Individual condominium units, private residences, vacation homes, property-management and corporate-housing portfolios, serviced-apartment operators, Airbnb / Vrbo inventory, ordinary apartments, timeshare and vacation-club inventory, residential-only towers, privately managed residences inside hotel towers, member-only club lodging and on-base military / government lodging are never admitted. A mixed hotel / condo / residence property is admitted only as the exact hotel premises its public operator sells as a hotel.
